channel.title: Agri & fertilisers · Market Pressure Map
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Agri & fertilisers in Indian markets. Today: headwind (−1.1).

item.title: [−3] Meghalaya records warmest year since 1901 in 2025, monsoon rainfall 43% below normal: IMD
item.description:
Signal: weak monsoon or sowing. 3 reports from Deccan Herald, CNBC TV18. Related: “Drought hits rabi sowing too”. New in the last 24 hours.

Agri & fertilisers: strong headwind (−3) — Crop output at risk

Why it matters: Poor rains hurt harvests and rural incomes, weighing on rural demand and raising food inflation.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −1, Growth outlook −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months

item.title: [+1] India, EU agree to boost trade, investment and technology ties ahead of landmark trade deal
item.description:
Signal: trade deal or tariff relief for India (India). 7 reports from The New Indian Express, ET Government, CNBC TV18 and 4 more. Related: “India, EU discuss free trade deal, technology and supply chain cooperation”. Ongoing: also reported on 3 of the previous 7 days (first 5 Nov).

Agri & fertilisers: mild tailwind (+1) — Farm exports gain access

Why it matters: Lower tariffs or a trade deal open markets for Indian exporters and attract investment into export manufacturing.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1, Rupee +1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: high · horizon: months
